correctness.rationale: Every one of 714 nonempty faces is reconstructed independently twice. A fixed complete toggle certificate has 341 disjoint elementary pairs and 32 critical simplices; all 2376 incidence arrows form a DAG. Two genuinely separate exact signed-integer cancellation procedures give the same zero 19-by-12 critical differential; the unpaired 3-skeleton is 2-connected and Hurewicz implies each four-cell attaches trivially. Raw mod-two boundary ranks independently agree.

value.rationale: The smallest balanced bidirected complete bipartite digraph with three vertices per part contains multiple interacting directed four-cycles and lies beyond bidirected polygon and one-way bipartite chessboard families. Its exact mixed-dimensional integral homotopy type and zero attaching-degree structure are motivated, non-obvious finite data that refine the graph complex literature, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a raw enumeration without topology.
